roadmap.title: Inner biomes and early unlocks
roadmap.description: Explore the inner biomes, defeat their bosses, and start pets, farming, and travel.

roadmap.title: Outer biomes and Titan souls
roadmap.description: Power the three statues beside the Core with their boss items. Speak to the Core and touch the Great Wall to open the outer biomes. Return to the Core for directions to the Titan Shrines. Defeat the six Titans and gather legendary weapon parts while exploring.

roadmap.title: Final bosses and late-game equipment
roadmap.description: Defeat the Core Commander, explore the Passage and Breaker's Reach, and finish the late-game bosses and legendary gear.

roadmap.title: Collections and skill cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the Oracle Deck, pet colors, cooking discoveries, seasonal trees, and every level-100 skill.

steps.text: Search the @loc{Dirt Biome} near the Core. Follow the screen tremors to @enemy{Glurch the Abominous Mass}, then defeat the slime.
Find the large circular tunnel through the @loc{Clay Caves} and @loc{Forgotten Ruins}. Attack @enemy{Ghorm the Devourer} as the boss follows that route.
Find @enemy{The Hive Mother} inside a @loc{Larva Hive} in the Clay Caves and defeat the boss.
Craft @item{Large Shiny Glimmering Object} and an @item{Azeos the Sky Titan Scanner} at the @loc{Ancient Shrine} in Azeos' Wilderness. Use the scanner to locate the arena.
Place the Large Shiny Glimmering Object in the arena to summon @enemy{Azeos the Sky Titan}. Break healing crystals with a pickaxe during the fight.
Gather 10 @item{Crystal Skull Shards}. Put the shards on the hotbar and hold the use button to make a @item{Skull of the Corrupted Shaman}.
Find the @loc{Throne Room} in the Forgotten Ruins. Use the skull on the central skull sigil, then defeat @enemy{Malugaz the Corrupted}.
Explore @loc{Azeos' Wilderness} and follow the screen tremors to @enemy{Ivy the Poisonous Mass}. Defeat the slime.
Craft an @item{Omoroth the Sea Titan Scanner} and @item{Expert Lure} at the Sunken Sea's @loc{Ancient Shrine}. Use the scanner to find the whirlpool arena.
Equip the Expert Lure in the off-hand slot. Fish in an arena whirlpool and reel in the bite to summon @enemy{Omoroth the Sea Titan}.
Fight from a @item{Speeder} with a ranged weapon. Keep moving around the tornadoes and destroy nearby tentacles.
Craft a @item{Morpha the Aquatic Mass Scanner} at an @item{Ancient Hologram Pod}. Use the scanner in the @loc{Sunken Sea} to find and defeat @enemy{Morpha the Aquatic Mass}.
Craft a @item{Ra-Akar the Sand Titan Scanner} and @item{Thumper} at the Desert of Beginnings' @loc{Ancient Shrine}. Use the scanner to find the arena.
Place the Thumper inside the arena to summon @enemy{Ra-Akar the Sand Titan}. Keep moving to avoid the homing orbs while attacking.
Use an @item{Igneous the Molten Mass Scanner} from an @item{Ancient Hologram Pod}. Find the boss in the @loc{Molten Quarry} within the Desert of Beginnings and defeat the slime.
Kill slimes until one drops a @item{Crown Summoning Idol}.
Place the idol on a slime boss's summoning rune, such as Glurch's. Defeat the summoned @enemy{King Slime}.
Mine walls that your tool can damage. Keep upgrading your pickaxe as you reach tougher biomes.
Cook ingredients in several @item{Cooking Pots} and collect the finished dishes. Keep cooking until the cooking skill reaches level 100.
Catch fish and treasure with a fishing rod until the fishing skill reaches level 100.
Plant and water crops, then harvest the mature plants by hand. Replant the seeds and continue until gardening reaches level 100.
Hit enemies with melee weapons until the melee combat skill reaches level 100. A weaker weapon lets you land more hits on each enemy.
Hit enemies with ranged weapons until the ranged combat skill reaches level 100. A weaker weapon lets you land more hits on each enemy.
Keep damaging enemies until vitality reaches level 100. Train vitality alongside your combat skills.
Travel on foot until running reaches level 100. Use movement speed equipment to cover distance faster.
Craft supplies as you progress. Use surplus wood to make @item{Wood Bridges} or walls until crafting reaches level 100.

guide.context: Collect one of each of the nine cards and the @item{Thread of Fate}. Keep the cards together in your inventory, then use the thread to bind the @item{Oracle Deck}.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Aura"
collectibles.method: Dig marked spots with a shovel.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Entity"
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Malugaz the Corrupted} until the card drops.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Metropolis"
collectibles.method: Spend 3,988 @item{Ancient Coins} at a @npc{Vending Machine} to buy the card.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Wisdom"
collectibles.method: Search the sewer scene for the card.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Radiance"
collectibles.method: Dig marked spots with a shovel.

collectibles.name: Oracle Card "Temperance"
collectibles.method: Fish until you catch the card.

collectibles.name: Thread of Fate
collectibles.method: Use @item{Fateful Echo} to mark the scene. Break the maze walls with at least 1,280 mining damage, remove the central furniture, and dig beneath the furniture.

steps.text: Buy @item{Rune Parchment} from the @npc{Cloaked Merchant} for 2,000 Ancient Coins.

Get a @item{Broken Handle} from Azeos or exploration chests. Find the @item{Chipped Blade} in a sealed Wilderness temple; use a Glow Tulip to open the entrance. Find a @item{Clear Gemstone} in a maze in the Forgotten Ruins or Wilderness.
Gather 10 @item{Ancient Gemstones} and 50 @item{Iron Bars}. Carry these materials and the three parts, then use the Rune Parchment to assemble Rune Song.

Search the three large @loc{Forlorn Metropolis} cities in the Sunken Sea. Loot their Broken Cores for @item{Channeling Gemstone}, @item{Fractured Limbs}, @item{Energy String}, @item{Shutdown Protocol}, @item{Anomaly Report}, and @item{Overwrite Transcript}.
Visit the @npc{Cloaked Merchant} and buy @item{Empty Crystal}. Combine the crystal with the three documents to make an @item{Admin Key}.
Use @item{Phantasmal Echo} to locate the island vault. Open the vault with the Admin Key and take the @item{Glyph Parchment}.
Gather 20 @item{Ancient Gemstones} and 100 @item{Octarine Bars}. Use the Glyph Parchment with these materials and the three weapon parts in your inventory.
Get an @item{Ancient Pickaxe} from @enemy{Azeos the Sky Titan} and @item{Cipher Parchment} from @enemy{Igneous the Molten Mass}.
Gather 400 @item{Gold Bars}, 600 @item{Scarlet Bars}, 600 @item{Octarine Bars}, 600 @item{Galaxite Bars}, and 100 @item{Ancient Gemstones}.
Find the @loc{Ancient Forge} in a large Molten Quarry. Stand beside the forge and use the Cipher Parchment with the pickaxe and materials in your inventory.

achievements.summary: Speak to a @enemy{Big Larva} while wearing @item{Larva Helm} and @item{Larva Chest}.

steps.text: Get @item{Larva Helm} from Larva Hive chests or the Hive Mother. Get @item{Larva Chest} from Larva Hive chests or Ghorm.
Equip both armor pieces. Approach a @enemy{Big Larva} in a Larva Hive and press the talk button.
Use a @item{Galaxite Fishing Rod} to fish in lava in the @loc{Molten Quarry}. Keep fishing until you catch a @item{Starlight Nautilus}.
Equip speed gear such as two @item{Polished Swift Rings}, @item{Polished Octarine Necklace}, @item{Morpha's Bubble Backpack}, and @item{Azeos' Dash Feather}.
Cook @item{Bloat Oat} with @item{Spirit Veil} and eat the dish. Add points to @mechanic{Gotta go fast!} and @mechanic{Pick and run!}, then mine a wall to trigger the temporary speed bonus.
Check your movement speed in the character stats. Add more speed gear, such as a @item{Towel} and @item{Board Shorts}, until the total exceeds 200%.

achievements.description: Discovered 100 recipes in the cook book
achievements.summary: Record 100 different recipes in the @mechanic{Cook Book}.

steps.text: Cook new pairs of crops, fish, and meat in a @item{Cooking Pot}. Include golden crops and pairs of identical ingredients. Check the @mechanic{Cook Book} and continue until 100 different recipes are recorded.
Plant and water crops such as @item{Heart Berries}. Harvest a plant that grows golden. The @mechanic{Expert gardener} talent increases the chance.

achievements.displayName: A Throne Fit for a King
achievements.description: Sit on a @item{Caveling Toilet} while wearing @item{King Slime Crown}.
achievements.summary: While wearing @item{King Slime Crown}, sit on a @item{Caveling Toilet}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{King Slime} for the @item{King Slime Crown}. Equip the crown, then sit on a @item{Caveling Toilet} in a Caveling town.

achievements.description: Equipped the Ring of Rock and Ring of Stone
achievements.summary: Equip both @item{Ring of Stone} and @item{Ring of Rock}.

steps.text: Look for @item{Ring of Rock} in early-biome chests or while mining stone walls. Find @item{Ring of Stone} while mining dirt or clay walls. Equip one ring in each ring slot.

achievements.description: Match your character's appearance to an @mechanic{official artwork character}.
achievements.summary: Match your character's appearance to an @mechanic{official artwork character}.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Magic Mirror} at a @item{Carpenter's Table} and use the mirror to edit your character.
Choose the male body, tan skin, bald hairstyle, middle-brown eyes, a dark green shirt, and dark purple pants. Confirm the appearance. Hair color does not matter with the bald hairstyle.
Select the @mechanic{Cherry Blossom} season override in the game menu. Collect @item{Pink Cherry Blossoms} or @item{White Cherry Blossoms} from the ground.
Combine 10 blossoms of one color into a matching Cherry Tree. Make and place 10 trees in the same world.

achievements.summary: Perform the @mechanic{Tune of Tempest} on a musical instrument.

steps.text: Equip any @item{musical instrument}. With the default keyboard controls, play @mechanic{X V W X V W} in a quick, steady rhythm.

achievements.description: Hatched your first pet from an egg

steps.text: Buy a @item{Curious Egg} from the @npc{Bearded Merchant}, or use another pet egg. Place the egg in an @item{Egg Incubator} powered by an @item{Electricity Generator}.
Wait 30 minutes for the egg to crack, then use the cracked egg to hatch the pet.
Use an @item{Atlantean Worm Scanner} from an @item{Ancient Hologram Pod} to track the boss in the @loc{Sunken Sea}.

Complete an @loc{Ancient Battle Arena} for a @item{Nuclear Battery}. Place the battery in a valid merchant house to summon the @npc{Brave Merchant}. Buy a @item{Bait Pillar} and place the pillar near the submerged worm.
Use a @item{Speeder} and ranged attacks to break the blue weak points. Destroy the smaller worms that split off as well.

achievements.description: Stored all color variations of one pet type in a chest
achievements.summary: Keep every color variation of one @item{pet type} together in a chest.

steps.text: Hatch @item{Loyal Eggs} until you have all 8 colors of @item{Subterrier}. Keep one pet of each color.
Place the 8 different Subterriers together in one chest.
Find a @npc{Moolin} or @npc{Bambuck} in a @loc{Meadow}. Hold a farmed crop near the animal and let the animal eat.

achievements.description: Reached max level on a pet

steps.text: Equip a pet and damage enemies alongside the pet until the pet reaches level 10. Use @item{Beast Boosters} to add pet experience when available.
Damage enemies with magic weapons until magic reaches level 100.
Use a summoning tome and let your minions hit enemies until summoning reaches level 100.

At the @loc{Hydra Ancient Shrine} in the Shimmering Frontier, craft a @item{Druidra the Wild Titan Scanner} and @item{Wind Organ of Wilderness}. The organ needs 20 @item{Gleam Wood Planks} and 10 @item{Solarite Bars}.
Use the scanner to track @enemy{Druidra the Wild Titan} in the @loc{Azeos' Wilderness}. Place the organ near the moving boss, then defeat the hydra.

At the @loc{Hydra Ancient Shrine} in the Shimmering Frontier, craft a @item{Crydra the Ice Titan Scanner} and @item{Wind Organ of Ice}. The organ needs 20 @item{Gleam Wood Planks} and 10 @item{Solarite Bars} and a @item{Pink Hydra Eye} from Druidra.
Use the scanner to track @enemy{Crydra the Ice Titan} in the @loc{Sunken Sea}. Place the organ near the moving boss, then defeat the hydra.

At the @loc{Hydra Ancient Shrine} in the Shimmering Frontier, craft a @item{Pyrdra the Fire Titan Scanner} and @item{Wind Organ of Fire}. The organ needs 20 @item{Gleam Wood Planks} and 10 @item{Solarite Bars} and a @item{White Hydra Eye} from Crydra.
Use the scanner to track @enemy{Pyrdra the Fire Titan} in the @loc{Desert of Beginnings}. Place the organ near the moving boss, then defeat the hydra.
Collect the six Titan souls by defeating @enemy{Azeos}, @enemy{Omoroth}, @enemy{Ra-Akar}, @enemy{Druidra}, @enemy{Crydra}, and @enemy{Pyrdra}.
Find the @loc{Crystal Meteor} in the Desert of Beginnings. Activate the meteor to start the Core Commander fight.
Destroy the three orbiting cores to make the boss vulnerable. Defeat both the Core Commander and the second form, @enemy{Unleashed Core Commander}.
Craft an @item{Urschleim Scanner} at a @item{Rift Statue} in the @loc{Passage}. Use the scanner to find the moving boss.
Break the three glowing bulbs to expose the head, then attack the head. Keep moving as Urschleim speeds up.

achievements.summary: Have at least 8 @mechanic{minions} active at once.

steps.text: Get Grim Hood from Igneous or lava slimes, Chieftain armor from Ghorm or larvae, and Puppet Rings from Ra-Akar or Golden Ancient Chests. Find Soul Medallion in Alien Tech Chests or as loot from Crydra or Pyrdra.
Equip @item{Grim Hood}, @item{Chieftain Tunic}, @item{Chieftain Shorts}, @item{Soul Medallion}, and two @item{Puppet Rings}. The armor set bonus and accessories raise your minion capacity above 8.
Use a @item{summoning tome} to summon at least 8 minions together.
Find an @item{Obliteration Ray} in an @item{Alien Tech Chest} or as loot from @enemy{Pyrdra the Fire Titan}.
At a @item{Rift Statue} in the Passage, combine the ray with 100 @item{Pandorium Bars}, 100 @item{Solarite Bars}, and 50 @item{Cytoplasm}.
Activate an @item{Ancient Waypoint}, then use the waypoint to teleport to another activated waypoint. Look for waypoints near bosses and Ancient Shrines.
Damage enemies with bombs or a mortar until explosives reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Kill @enemy{Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands}.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands}.

steps.text: At the @loc{Ancient Shrine} in the Passage, craft the @item{Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands Scanner} and @item{Corrupted Sap}. The sap needs @item{Hardened Sap}, 20 @item{Pandorium Bars}, and 20 @item{Cytoplasm}.
Use the scanner to find the Oasis arena in the @loc{Desert of Beginnings}. Place Corrupted Sap on the summoning rune, then defeat Nimruza.
Kill @enemy{Void Cavelings} in @loc{Breaker's Reach} for 10 @item{Oblivion Fragments}. Use the fragments from your hotbar to make a @item{Wind Organ of Void}.
Kill @enemy{S.A.H.A.B.A.R.} and take @item{Void Idol}. Place the idol in a valid merchant house to bring in the @npc{Otherworldly Merchant}.
Buy an @item{Oblidra the Void Lord Scanner} from the @npc{Otherworldly Merchant}. Track the moving boss and place the organ nearby. Defeat @enemy{Oblidra the Void Lord}.
Get @item{Brood Void Neuron} from Nimruza. Travel north from the Core, cross the Passage, and use the neuron to open the gate into @loc{Breaker's Reach}.
Craft a @item{S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Scanner} and @item{Profane Override} at the Ancient Shrine in Breaker's Reach. Follow the scanner and place the override on the boss's summoning circle.
Disable all four legs together to expose the body. Defeat both phases of S.A.H.A.B.A.R.

Fight @enemy{S.A.H.A.B.A.R.} for @item{S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s Mortar Housing}. Put the @item{Void Idol} dropped by the boss in a valid merchant house. Buy @item{Schematic Parchment} from the arriving @npc{Otherworldly Merchant} for 5,000 Ancient Coins.

Find the two component puzzle structures in @loc{Breaker's Reach}. In the cage puzzle, lure each of the four enemies into a separate enclosure. Close each enclosure behind the enemy to unlock the reward room.

In the timed key puzzle, shoot the targets and use the pressure plates to pass the synchronized doors and bring the key to you. Use the key to reach the reward. Collect @item{Sanctified Firing Core} and @item{Void-Forged Barrel} from the two puzzles.
Carry the mortar housing, barrel, and firing core. Use the Schematic Parchment to assemble Credence of Ruin.
Collect @item{Coiled Branch} from Druidra, @item{Frozen Orb} from Crydra, and @item{Magma Rod} from Pyrdra. Fight the hydras again if a part does not drop.
With the three parts in your inventory, use any one of the parts to combine them into Titan Breath.

achievements.description: Equipped a Hookshot and the Explorer's vanity set
achievements.summary: Wear the complete @item{Explorer's armor set} with a @item{Hookshot} or @item{Gilded Hookshot} equipped.

steps.text: At a @item{Loom}, make @item{Explorer's Pants}, @item{Explorer's Hat}, and @item{Explorer's Jacket}.
Get a @item{Hookshot} by fishing in the Forgotten Ruins or defeating Malugaz. Equip the hookshot in the off-hand slot and all three Explorer pieces in the actual armor slots.

achievements.summary: Ride a @npc{cattle animal} using a @item{Saddle} or @item{Racing Saddle}.

steps.text: At a @item{Livestock Workbench}, craft a @item{Saddle} with 8 @item{Iron Bars}, 3 @item{Tin Bars}, and 8 @item{Fiber}.
Use the saddle on a cattle animal, then mount the animal.
Find @loc{Chamber of the Veil Crux} by exploring the Desert of Beginnings. Alternatively, use @item{Veil Echo} from Nimruza to mark the chamber.
Get @item{Runestone Scepter} from Malugaz or Caveling Shamans. Get @item{Blightbloom Scepter} from Azeos or Wilderness chests.
Fish in seawater for @item{Abyssal Scepter}. Search @item{Solarite Chests}, @item{Locked Solarite Chests}, or @item{Cultist Chests} for @item{Hollowcore Scepter}.
At a @item{Rift Statue} in the Passage, craft @item{Pandoric Scepter} with 30 @item{Pandorium Bars} and 15 @item{Cytoplasm}.
Place each scepter on the chamber pedestal matching the scepter's biome. Enter the opened central room, disable the @item{Ward Coil}, and collect Veil Crux.

achievements.description: Stored 3 different kinds of Go-Karts in a chest
achievements.summary: Store three different @item{Go-Kart types} together in one chest.

steps.text: Make a @item{Go-Kart Workbench} at a @item{Galaxite Workbench}.
At the vehicle workbench, make @item{Speeder Go-Kart}, @item{Primitive Go-Kart}, and @item{Renegade Go-Kart}.
Put all three karts in the same chest.
